extracted.intended_audience: credentialed media, beat reporters, and sports media relations staff covering NBA teams
extracted.subtask_description: Team media-guide style logistical and contact information for credentialed media covering NBA games, including media entrances, parking, will-call, credential pickup, directions, and primary communications contacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Directions from airport to FedExForum
rubrics_metrics.description: FROM AIRPORT TO FEDEXFORUM: From the airport follow the signage that leads to Interstate 240. Merge onto the Downtown/Little Rock exit which is I-240 West. Once on I-240 West, continue going West (straight) through I-55/I-240 interchange which turns into I-55 North. While traveling on I-55 N, stay to the left to avoid sudden exits. I-55 North will merge into Riverside Drive. Merge left, following the signage that reads to Downtown/Riverside Dr. Travel Riverside Dr. N to Beale St., turn right. Take Beale St. to the first stop light (Front St.), and turn right. Take Front St. to Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Avenue, turn left. FedExForum is on the corner of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Avenue and B.B. King Blvd.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Step-by-step driving directions intended for media traveling from the airport to FedExForum; follow signage for I-240 and I-55, stay left through merge points, and follow city streets to arena corner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Memphis media entrance location
rubrics_metrics.description: MEDIA ENTRANCE: Located at the Practice Court Hallway Entrance on Level P1 of the parking garage, near the P1 elevators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the precise door/location credentialed media should use to access the arena media areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Memphis media parking policy
rubrics_metrics.description: PARKING: Media parking is provided to credentialed media by contacting the Memphis Grizzlies Communications Department. The parking lot, located on Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Avenue, is directly across from the parking garage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media must be credentialed and contact the Communications Department to obtain parking; gives lot location relative to the garage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Listings of writers regularly assigned to the club (beat contacts)
rubrics_metrics.description: WRITERS REGULARLY ASSIGNED TO CLUB — lists names, outlets, addresses, phone numbers, emails, and X handles (examples: DAMICHAEL COLE, MEMPHIS COMMERCIAL APPEAL; DREW HILL, DAILY MEMPHIAN).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides beat reporters and contact information that media relations and others can use for coordination, credentialing questions, or press outreach; signals which reporters regularly cover the team.

rubrics_metrics.name: Kaseya Center directions from Miami International Airport
rubrics_metrics.description: KASEYA CENTER (FROM MIAMI INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT): Take 836 East to Biscayne Blvd. Exit. Make a right onto Biscayne Blvd. Go down Biscayne, arena is on the left on NE 8th Street.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple driving directions for media arriving via Miami International Airport to the arena.

rubrics_metrics.name: Kaseya Center will call and press entrance
rubrics_metrics.description: Courtside: Press Room: (786) 777-3805 (786) 777-4486; MEDIA WILL CALL AND PRESS ENTRANCE: Located at the south-west corner of the building at the Command Center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies phone numbers and the physical location (south-west corner/Command Center) for media will-call and press entrance at the arena.

rubrics_metrics.name: Milwaukee Fiserv Forum directions
rubrics_metrics.description: DIRECTIONS TO: FISERV FORUM: 1111 Vel R. Phillips Ave., Milwaukee, WI 53203 – (From Airport/ South): Take I-94 West (North) to I-43 North (toward Green Bay). Take McKinley Ave. exit and go right, proceed to first stoplight and turn right onto 6th St. Fiserv Forum is one block ahead on the left. (From North): Take I-43 South to McKinley Ave. exit and go left. Turn right onto 6th St. Fiserv Forum is one block ahead on the left. (From West): Take I-94 East to I-43 North (toward Green Bay). Continue on I-43 North to McKinley Ave. exit and go right. Turn right onto 6th St. Fiserv Forum is one block ahead on the left.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multi-direction driving instructions for media arriving from various directions to Fiserv Forum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fiserv Forum credential pickup timing and location
rubrics_metrics.description: MEDIA ENTRANCE: Individual game credentials may be picked up at the Service Entrance to Fiserv Forum, located on the south side of the arena near the intersection of Sixth St. and Highland Ave. Credentials are available for pick up 2.5 hours prior to game time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies where and when game credentials can be collected — service entrance on south side near Sixth & Highland, and pickup opens 2.5 hours before tipoff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target Center will call location
rubrics_metrics.description: WILL CALL LOCATION: Main ticket lobby on the corner of First Avenue and Sixth Street.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies the arena's will-call/ticket pickup area for media and guests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target Center media entrance and pass pickup procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: MEDIA ENTRANCE: Media members can pick up passes and enter Target Center through the Timberwolves and Lynx Tom Hanneman Media Room entrance. Enter through the Target Center Lobby, which is on the corner of First Avenue and Sixth St. Enter there and take the stairs/escalator up to the Skyway level and continue walking straight past all the entry gates. There will be a staircase on the left-hand side to take you down to the credential check-in table.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stepwise routing through the lobby to the media room and credential check-in; clarifies the path media should use to pick up passes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target Center media parking guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: MEDIA PARKING: There is no designated media parking area, but the Seventh Street (a.k.a. Ramp A) and Fifth Street (a.k.a. Ramp B) parking ramps are connected to the building via Skyway. From either ramp, go to Level 3 and follow the Skyway into Target Center. Once inside Target Center, take the elevator or stairs down one floor, the media room is to the left.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains that media must use public parking ramps connected by Skyway, with routing from Level 3 into the arena and down to the media room; explicitly notes lack of a dedicated media lot.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target Center directions from Minneapolis Airport
rubrics_metrics.description: TARGET CENTER (FROM MINNEAPOLIS AIRPORT): Exit the airport and take 494 West. Stay on 494 until 35W North. Take 35W North to the 5th Avenue exit and go left on 7th Street. Follow 7th Street to First Avenue.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Driving directions for media traveling from Minneapolis Airport to the arena.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary team communications contacts and phone/email listings
rubrics_metrics.description: Each team lists primary communications and media relations staff with office and cell phone numbers and emails (examples: Laura Ehret, Vice President, Communications & Basketball Information Strategy — O-(901) 205-1114 C-(901) 440-7115 lehret@grizzlies.com; Tim Donovan, Vice President, Sports Media Relations — O-(786) 777-4465 C-(305) 496-1858 tim@heat.com; Barry Baum, Chief Communications Officer — O-(414) 908-3781 C-(917) 847-1737 bbaum@bucks.com; Patrick Rees, Chief Communications Officer — O-(612) 673-8366 C-(202) 365-7920 patrick.rees@timberwolves.com; Greg Bensel, Sr. VP Communications & Broadcasting — O-(504) 593-3759 C-(504) 453-2318 greg.bensel@pelicans.com).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as the authoritative contact points for media inquiries, credential requests, interview coordination, and other PR needs; includes courtside/press-room phone numbers where provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lists of team broadcasters, radio/TV outlets, and wire/internet media contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Team media guides provide extensive listings of team broadcasters, regional and national radio and TV outlets, wire services, internet media, and other partners with names, titles, phone numbers, emails, and sometimes studio call-in numbers (examples across entries for Grizzlies, Heat, Bucks, Timberwolves, Pelicans).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended for media coordination and broadcast planning; identifies official broadcasting partners and contact points for access, interviews, and logistics.
